title: BTS Closes Toronto Stand With Tour-Debut 'Zero O'Clock,' First 'Outro: Tear' Since 2019
detail: August 23, 2026 — BTS closed its two-night Rogers Stadium stand in Toronto with two setlist rarities: the ARIRANG World Tour debut of '00:00 (Zero O'Clock)' and the group's first live performance of 'Outro: Tear' since 2019, alongside the returning main set, per setlist.fm. The Fan Plaza opened at 4:30 p.m. and doors at 5:30 p.m. ahead of the roughly 8 p.m. start. The weekend stand — Canada's only stop on the 88-show, 34-city ARIRANG World Tour and BTS's first Toronto shows in 11 years — drew an estimated 100,000 fans across both nights to the specially built 360-degree in-the-round stage. The tour now advances to two nights at Chicago's Soldier Field (Aug 27-28).

media.caption: BTS fans fill Rogers Stadium in Toronto as the group wraps its only Canadian tour stop.
